name: Holo3.1 (0.8B, 4B, 9B, 35B-A3B)

lineage.how_derived: fine-tuned for computer use and UI grounding (card; training details not given)

purpose: Vision-language models for computer-use agents on web, desktop and mobile; adds mobile support, native function calling and quantized checkpoints for local deployment (card, blog).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: card metadata and card text both say Apache 2.0; the repos have no LICENSE file; base models are Qwen (Apache-2.0)

architecture.kind: Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6 based vision-language (qwen3_5 dense for 0.8B/4B/9B, qwen3_5_moe for 35B-A3B)
architecture.why_this_design: not stated beyond "building on Holo3"; the benchmark table is an image on the card

variants.notes: q4_k_m 21.3 GB, mmproj 0.90 GB, bf16 69.4 GB, imatrix; 72,147 downloads
5.17B parameters per the HF API (vision tower included); research/52 listed a 3.07 GB Q4_K_M GGUF of the 4B

pc-16gb.notes: 4B/9B quantized; the 35B-A3B Q4 (21 GB) needs expert offload

pc-24gb.notes: 35B-A3B Q4_K_M 21.3 GB plus mmproj is tight with context

engine_support.notes: qwen3.5 family architecture already runs in Tona for text (qwen35moe); vision tower and mmproj are not loaded; official GGUF with mmproj exists

benchmarks.name: OSWorld (35B-A3B BF16)
benchmarks.variant: FP8 and NVFP4 about 77.8; blog text only, other numbers are in images

benchmarks.name: overall average over computer use, mobile, workflows, grounding (35B-A3B)

strengths: purpose-built for UI grounding and computer use, native function calling
quantized checkpoints published by the vendor
weaknesses: not a document reader; English only stated
benchmark tables on the card are images, numbers need confirmation
best_for: agents that click through screens and screenshots
avoid_for: document OCR and parsing (use a parser from this database)
soft.maturity: H Company, successive Holo releases (Holo3 in March 2026, 3.1 in May/June 2026)

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0, sizes for every hardware class, same architecture family Tona already runs for text; relevant for computer-use agents, not for document work. Missing vision loading is a blocker only.
blockers: vision tower / mmproj not loaded by Tona

sources.note: raw README via the HF raw path after the first fetch returned 401
blog read through a summarizer; says release 2026-06-01

open_questions: benchmark values that appear only as images on the card (ScreenSpot-Pro, OSWorld-G, per-size tables)
license text (no LICENSE file in the repos)
